focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期总结报告，强调进口商申报数据质量要求将显著提高，并计划对未合规申报实施处罚。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，需尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系，完善供应链碳排放数据收集，并评估在欧盟境内设立合规实体的必要性。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission's recent stocktaking report stresses that data quality requirements for importers' declarations will be significantly tightened, and penalties for non-compliant reporting are planned. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure. They should promptly establish product carbon footprint accounting systems, improve supply chain emissions data collection, and assess the need to set up compliance entities within the EU.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例适用《新加坡调解公约》作出商事调解协议执行令，跨境争议解决路径拓宽
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期在一起跨境货物买卖纠纷中，依据《新加坡调解公约》首次作出执行令，承认并执行一项国际商事调解协议。该案涉及中国卖方与东南亚买方之间的质量争议，经调解达成和解后，一方未履行，另一方遂向SICC申请执行。法院确认调解协议符合公约要求，裁定可执行。此案为《公约》缔约国间的调解协议跨境执行提供了重要先例，提示中国出海企业可在合同中优先约定调解条款并选择新加坡作为调解地。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭公报 · 2026.10
case.title_en: SICC Issues First Enforcement Order for Mediated Settlement under Singapore Convention, Broadening Cross-Border Dispute Resolution
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) has recently issued its first enforcement order under the Singapore Convention on Mediation, recognising and enforcing an international commercial mediated settlement in a cross-border sale of goods dispute. The case involved a quality dispute between a Chinese seller and a Southeast Asian buyer; a settlement was reached through mediation, but one party failed to comply, prompting the other to seek enforcement before the SICC. The court confirmed the settlement met the Convention's requirements and ruled it enforceable. This landmark decision provides an important precedent for cross-border enforcement of mediated settlements among Convention states and suggests that Chinese outbound enterprises may prioritise mediation clauses and choose Singapore as the mediation seat in contracts.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”解决平台上线，实现调解、仲裁、诉讼在线衔接
policy.summary: 广东省高级人民法院与香港律政司、澳门法务局近期联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解决平台。该平台整合三地调解、仲裁与诉讼资源，允许当事人通过单一入口提交争议解决申请，并实现电子送达、在线调解及仲裁裁决转诉讼保全等功能的衔接。平台首阶段覆盖货物买卖、投资争端等常见跨境商事纠纷，旨在降低跨境解纷成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境。企业应关注平台规则，善用在线调解机制高效化解跨境争议。
policy.source: 来源：广东省高级人民法院、香港律政司联合发布 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: GBA Launches One-Stop Online Platform for Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution, Linking Mediation, Arbitration and Litigation
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong High People's Court, the Hong Kong Department of Justice and Macao's Legal Affairs Bureau have jointly launched a one-stop online platform for cross-border commercial dispute resolution in the Greater Bay Area (GBA). The platform integrates mediation, arbitration and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions, allowing parties to submit dispute resolution applications through a single portal and enabling e-service, online mediation and the transfer of arbitral awards to litigation preservation measures. Initially covering common cross-border commercial disputes such as sale of goods and investment disputes, it aims to reduce dispute resolution costs and enhance the rule-of-law business environment in the GBA. Enterprises should familiarise themselves with the platform rules and leverage online mediation for efficient resolution of cross-border disputes.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong High People's Court & Hong Kong Department of Justice joint release · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中国科技企业赴美投资须重构合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期发布对外投资审查规则修订草案，拟将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等领域的投资限制扩展至更多交易类型，并强化对间接投资和合资架构的审查。中国科技企业通过离岸主体赴美投资或与美方设立合资公司时，须提前进行交易架构合规评估，识别是否落入禁止或申报类别；建议在交易文件中设置监管审批先决条件及分手费条款，并建立投后合规监控机制，以降低被强制撤资或处罚的风险。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部、律所实务观察 · 2026.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Review Rules Require Chinese Tech Firms to Restructure Compliance Architecture for US Investments
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Department of the Treasury has recently issued draft amendments to outbound investment review rules, proposing to extend investment restrictions in semiconductors, artificial intelligence and quantum computing to more transaction types and to strengthen scrutiny of indirect investments and joint venture structures. Chinese tech companies investing in the US through offshore entities or forming joint ventures with US parties must conduct pre-transaction compliance assessments to identify whether a deal falls into prohibited or notifiable categories. It is advisable to include regulatory approval conditions precedent and break-fee clauses in transaction documents and to establish post-investment compliance monitoring mechanisms to mitigate the risk of forced divestment or penalties.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury; law firm practice observations · Oct 2026
